scope: One real theme page, its 13 immutable original sources, and 5 already-authored AMP memories. Questions authored from these sources; not independent held-out natural-user requests.
evaluation: All required atoms in the returned top-5 evidence. Regex accepts source text and predeclared equivalent Japanese descriptions. No answer-generation model. Diagnostics alone do not count as an explanatory answer.
